# Weekdays Mon-Fri in 2018-04 with 24 values
qualifying = []
for date, v in sorted(vals.items()):
    if not date.startswith('2018-04'):
        continue
    dt = datetime.strptime(date, '%Y-%m-%d')
    if dt.weekday() <= 4 and len(v) == 24:
        qualifying.append((date, sum(v)))

for q in qualifying:
    print(q[0], q[1])

mean = sum(q[1] for q in qualifying)/len(qualifying)
print('num days', len(qualifying))
print('mean', mean)
